title: 2100 Prairie's balcony reaches the library, on a pier and pierced rail
items: 2100 Prairie's porch balcony now runs from the library's projecting front to beside the parlour's upper window, as the old photograph and the 1876 plan show. A plain square stone pier carries its south end, and the cluster of three columns now stands just inside its north end. The balcony's rail is now a stone band pierced with round openings instead of square balusters. The flight is narrowed to the photograph's 2.3 m, between the pier and the columns, with a low stone terrace on each side.
